entries.title: Weather: Rayleigh/Mie atmosphere, volumetric clouds, sun, environment lighting, fog
entries.summary: Physically based sky LUT, Worley–Perlin raymarched clouds with Beer–powder + dual-lobe HG silver lining + fire-bounce underglow (single-pass analytic cloud dome on Low tier), optical-depth cloud shadows on every lit surface, cloud-bearing reflection environment + PMREM, aerial perspective, and SunWeather hooks for SunFx. Wind-reprojected cloud decks share altitude-dependent sunset lighting with aircraft and ice trails. Mirrors reuse visible cloud detail and capture the rest of the sky independently. Lunar phase follows the game clock’s sun and moon directions or an authored illuminated fraction.

entries.title: Inflatable soft bodies: spring + ideal-gas pressure solver (GPU + CPU)
entries.summary: Closed-manifold inflatable soft-body system (SoftBodySystem) with structural surface springs, internal cross-bracing struts and ideal-gas internal pressure (P ∝ V_target / V). WebGPU compute Jacobi solver with automatic CPU Gauss–Seidel fallback; couples into wind, blasts, water buoyancy (Ocean / InlandWater / waterLevel) and Rapier sphere/cuboid/capsule colliders with two-way impulse transfer. Built-ins: ball, cushion, buoy, torus, custom BufferGeometry; live inflate() and puncture().

Rest-pose recovery, unified wind + travelling flutter, underwater kelp buoyancy + orbital surge, rotor/jet downwash with swirl, blast waves, sphere and oriented-box vehicle interactors (addVehicle), frustum/distance LOD, and dual-lobe shifted-cuticle Kajiya–Kay anisotropic ribbon shading.

entries.title: Lava flow / lava lake
entries.summary: Ocean surface with clarity 0, absorption replaced by blackbody emission from the foam field (crust = low Jacobian, cracks = high), viscosity via damping; Explosions magma archetype + fire pool for embers.

entries.title: Snowstorm / blizzard
entries.summary: Rain module with fall speed 0.8–2.2 m/s, streak length → 0, larger soft sprites and strong wind turbulence; weather storm preset with cold turbidity; mist pool for spindrift.

entries.title: River rapids, waterfall valley and buoyant inflatables
entries.summary: InlandWater with RIVER_PRESETS.mountainRapids + Waterfall(WATERFALL_PRESETS.cascade), StrandSystem riverside grass + submerged kelp driven by inland.flowAt(), SoftBodySystem inflatable buoys and life rings floating on inland water, PBR materials (titanium, timber, seaSprayGlass) and TracerField skipping stones over water and breakaway cards; SunFx(goldenHour).

entries.title: Custom tsunami / surf break / dam burst
entries.summary: Tune height, width, speed and breaking; multiple Tsunami instances summed for wave trains; low breaking + long width = tidal bore, high breaking + short width = surfable barrel.

params.name: width/height

entries.title: Shoreline, basin connectivity and editable sand
entries.summary: Project a shoreline spline, propagate a sill height inland, stamp soles or tires and retain water in edited ground.

params.name: runnelDepth
params.note: Maximum relief of narrow return-flow channels cut into the generated foreshore.

params.name: grainMm
params.note: Positive mean grain diameter.

params.name: paleFraction
params.note: Area occupied by pale quartz or shell inclusions. The pale and heavy fractions total at most one.

params.name: heavyFraction
params.note: Area occupied by dense minerals. The matrix fills the remaining area.

params.name: drainageSeconds
params.note: Positive e-folding time for the exposed film.

params.name: period
params.note: Positive swash cycle.

params.name: detail
params.note: Optional fine swash atlas around a host obstacle. Centre x/z and size are in metres. Resolution counts samples per axis.

params.name: barrierAt
params.note: World Y of the sill at XZ. Return negative infinity in open water.

params.name: strength
params.note: Run-up amplitude.

params.name: imprint
params.note: Sole or wheel width and length in metres, yaw in radians from +Z toward +X.

params.name: pools
params.note: Game-owned basin descriptors with fractional shoreline position, cross-shore distance, radius, floor and lip in metres.

params.name: retainAt
params.note: World XZ tile-centre predicate that gives edited landmarks higher eviction priority.

params.name: stir
params.note: Submerged disk in world XZ, radius in metres (0,4], and a nonnegative suspended concentration increment.

params.name: save
params.note: Versioned edited tiles with seed, 4 cm cell spacing, simulation time and quantised state.

entries.title: Attach coastal contact to an existing game
entries.summary: Sample independently loaded tires on game-owned soil, road decks and bridges with a retained film per wheel.

params.name: heightAt
params.note: Host terrain height at world XZ.

params.name: deckAt
params.note: Return stable layer ID, standing water in metres, film and soil fractions at contact XYZ.

params.name: layer
params.note: One to eight contact surface IDs including ground.

params.name: wheel
params.note: One handle per tire. Width, radius and tread groove depths in metres.

params.name: save
params.note: Versioned edited tiles with seed, 4 cm cell spacing, simulation time and quantised state.

entries.title: Five world-space cloud and precipitation formations
entries.summary: A seeded, advected map drives cloud layers, rain, shadows and gusts at each position.

params.name: seed
params.note: Unsigned 32-bit subsystem seed.

params.name: span
params.note: Positive spatial repeat distance.

params.name: heading
params.note: From +X toward +Z.

params.name: upperCrosswind
params.note: Cross-front component of high-cloud drift. The cloud veil and its weather map share this world velocity.

params.name: lifeSeconds
params.note: Growth and evaporation cycle along the moving lower cloud group. High ice evolves on a longer clock.

params.name: coverageAt
params.note: Supply world XZ, simulation seconds and upper/lower selector.

entries.title: Regional water film for boots, vehicles and boats
entries.summary: Submersion, drainage and absorption for a material band on a moving object.

params.name: bottom
params.note: Local lower film band.

params.name: top
params.note: Local upper band above bottom.

params.name: drainageSeconds
params.note: Positive e-folding time for the exposed film.

params.name: shedding
params.note: Emerging surface film drainage rate.

entries.title: Light a covered outdoor space
entries.summary: Bounded cool light from a roof opening and warmer irradiance from nearby sunlit ground.

params.name: center
params.note: World XYZ.

params.name: halfSize
params.note: Positive local half-extents.

params.name: towardsOpenSky
params.note: World-space opening direction.

params.name: groundColor
params.note: Reflected-ground colour.

entries.title: Roof runoff, cambered gutters and storm grates
entries.summary: Store roof rain, route the downspout to a finite street volume, block or clear a grate, and query individual tire depths.

params.name: catchment
params.note: Origin XZ, width and length in metres, 2–256 cells per axis, surveyed ground and optional initial depth (m).

params.name: roof
params.note: Contributing square metres, drainage time in seconds, downspout outlet XZ in metres.

params.name: drains
params.note: Locations in metres, capacity in L/s and open fraction 0–1.

params.name: rainMmHour
params.note: Nonnegative rainfall and evaporation over the roof and street.

entries.title: Tidal inlet and sediment transport
entries.summary: Route a reversing current over a sill. Conserve water, suspended mineral and settled sediment between a surveyed shore and an open sea.

params.name: inlet
params.note: Survey corner XZ (m), 3–256 rows/columns, square spacing (m), sampled bed elevation (m), one open sea edge (west/east/south/north) and optional mouthAt(X,Z). Sea level and optional initial cell stages in m.

params.name: inletSediment
params.note: bedSiltAt in kg/m², seaSiltKgM3 in kg/m³, settlingMps in m/s, nonnegative Manning roughness in s/m^(1/3). stir(x,z,kg) returns the mass lifted from that cell.

params.name: drifter
params.note: Host ground and stage in m, current in m/s. Positive draft (m) and hydrodynamic drag time (s); grounded wrack refloats once local depth exceeds 1.15 drafts.

entries.title: Editable wind-blown sand above a compact bed
entries.summary: Cut, shear, slump and deposit a conserved layer above existing terrain. Restore the edited depth and sample the visible bed.

params.name: dune
params.note: Game-owned centre XZ and width in metres, resolution 5–193, thickness in metres, root cover 0–1, coarseFractionAt(x,z) by volume 0–1, coarseMobility 0–1, rippleHeading in radians from +X toward +Z, dry slope 12–55 degrees and seed.

entries.title: Terrain horizon and finite solar disc
entries.summary: Cache local terrain occlusion for any ground, water or airborne receiver.

params.name: heightAt
params.note: Host terrain height at world XZ.

params.name: horizon
params.note: Terrain shadow extent, centre and reach in metres. Resolution is 3 to 257 samples per axis.

entries.title: Editable clear, humid and dusty air
entries.summary: Set atmospheric turbidity and visibility independently of lighting exposure, weather or clock.

params.name: air
params.note: Named air or a game-owned turbidity (1–16) and meteorological visibility (100–300000 m). Preserves clock and exposure.

params.name: coast
params.note: Spline, material and landform controls.

params.name: front
params.note: Seeded regional weather configuration.

params.name: clock
params.note: Latitude, calendar day, local solar hour and world north.

params.name: horizon
params.note: Terrain shadow extent, centre and reach in metres. Resolution is 3 to 257 samples per axis.

params.name: air
params.note: Named air or a game-owned turbidity (1–16) and meteorological visibility (100–300000 m). Preserves clock and exposure.

params.name: dune
params.note: Game-owned centre XZ and width in metres, resolution 5–193, thickness in metres, root cover 0–1, coarseFractionAt(x,z) by volume 0–1, coarseMobility 0–1, rippleHeading in radians from +X toward +Z, dry slope 12–55 degrees and seed.

params.name: inlet
params.note: Survey corner XZ (m), 3–256 rows/columns, square spacing (m), sampled bed elevation (m), one open sea edge (west/east/south/north) and optional mouthAt(X,Z). Sea level and optional initial cell stages in m.

params.name: terrain
params.note: Square game-owned elevation grid in world metres.

params.name: gridFocus
params.note: Centred inner width in metres and number of inner segments. Remaining segments divide evenly between outer edges.

params.name: tide
params.note: Amplitude in metres, period in seconds and phase in cycles (0.25 at high water).

params.name: detail
params.note: Optional fine swash atlas around a host obstacle. Centre x/z and size are in metres. Resolution counts samples per axis.

params.name: exposureResponse
params.note: Positive e-folding times for brighten/darken, local sun/cloud/sky metering and optional compensationEV from -8 to +8 stops.

params.name: skyGlow
params.note: Town centre XZ, radius in metres, colour and intensity.

params.name: setFocus
params.note: World XYZ near-field camera, character, tire or hull position.

params.name: setLook
params.note: Named look or game-owned palette. Preserves physical state.
